caption: The drawing depicts an upright, rectangular piano with elaborate decorative details. The piano is predominantly brown, suggesting a wood construction, with various shades indicating the grain and texture. The front panel of the piano, above the keys, features ornate gold-colored decorations and floral motifs. The keyboard is white with black keys, and a sheet music stand is positioned at the center above the keyboard. The piano stands on four turned and carved legs, which appear twisted and are also brown with some highlighted gold accents, especially near the top where there are additional gold circular and floral embellishments. A brass or gold-colored ring handle is visible at the front of the two central legs. The background is plain, with a light beige color, and there are no additional objects present. Text is inscribed below the piano drawing, providing information about the piano style, date, and dimensions, as well as the artist and museum details.
title: Piano
